2609.03478.title: AutoGraphForge: Towards Automated Graph Theory Discovery
2609.03478.paper_summary: We report on our ongoing project to develop a computational pipeline, AutoGraphForge, for an automated graph-theoretic conjecturing-refuting-formalizing-proving system. Conjecture generation is counterexample-guided and runs in rounds: a Graffiti3 generator proposes conjectures over a small, evolving snapshot table $T$ (initially a few hundred graphs with their computed invariants) that grows only by counterexamples to its own conjectures. A novelty filter of $559$ classical and folklore relations, closed under transitive composition and linear identity substitution, decides via a linear program whether a candidate is already implied by known results. Surviving candidates are tested against a dataset of about $348,000$ graphs, unioning the complete House of Graphs invariant export, the exhaustive census of all connected graphs on at most nine vertices, several extremal families (strongly regular, minimal Ramsey, Cayley, cages, barbells, lollipops, spiders), and random models. Counterexample-search algorithms then attack the remainder. Run for several rounds on an HPC cluster, the loop yields $6,522$ conjectures that survived the refutation dataset, the novelty filter and every active-search run -- among them nontrivial relations between the annihilation number and the edge-cover number for bipartite and regular graphs, which we prove by hand. A subsequent formalization and proving stage deterministically translates each surviving conjecture into a Lean 4 statement skeleton; every candidate proof is kernel-verified against a pinned mathlib4 and our custom invariant preamble. This stage integrates two neural provers -- DeepSeek-Prover-V2-671B (served with vLLM) and the Lean-specialised OProver-32B -- behind the independent kernel check. It is implemented end-to-end and passes initial sanity checks, with the full pipeline currently running on the cluster.
2609.03478.paper_summary_zh: 我們報告我們正在進行的項目，開發一個計算管道 AutoGraphForge，用於自動化的圖論猜想-反駁-形式化-證明系統。猜想生成是以反例為指導並且分輪次進行：一個 Graffiti3 生成器在一個小的、演變中的快照表 $T$ 上提出猜想（最初是幾百個圖及其計算出的不變量），這個表僅通過對其自身猜想的反例來增長。一個包含 $559$ 個經典和民間關係的創新過濾器，在傳遞合成和線性身份替換下是封閉的，通過線性程序決定候選者是否已經由已知結果所暗示。存活的候選者會在約 $348,000$ 個圖的數據集上進行測試，這些圖包括完整的圖的家族不變量導出、最多九個頂點的所有連通圖的詳細普查、幾個極端家族（強正則、最小拉姆齊、凱利、籠子、杠鈴、棒棒糖、蜘蛛）和隨機模型。然後，反例搜索算法攻擊剩餘部分。在 HPC 集群上運行幾輪後，這個循環產生了 $6,522$ 個在反駁數據集、新穎過濾器和每次主動搜索運行中存活的猜想——其中包括二部圖和正則圖的消滅數與邊覆蓋數之間的非平凡關係，我們手動證明了這一點。隨後的形式化和證明階段確定性地將每個存活的猜想轉換為 Lean 4 語句骨架；每個候選證明都會對照固定的 mathlib4 和我們的自定義不變前言進行內核驗證。這一階段整合了兩個神經證明者——DeepSeek-Prover-V2-671B（使用 vLLM 服務）和 Lean 專用的 OProver-32B——在獨立的內核檢查後面。它是端到端實現的並通過了初步的合理性檢查，目前完整的管道正在集群上運行。
2609.03478.author: Ján Pastorek et.al.
